keys.note: FIXED TEST KEYS — deterministic, public, never use outside fixtures.

client.role: extension session keypair (X25519, regenerated per handshake)

host.role: app/host session keypair (X25519, regenerated per handshake)

identity.role: extension PERMANENT identification keypair (public half sent as `idKey`)

database.note: Fake database values used by the vectors.

nonceRule: Requests use one 24-byte nonce; the response uses the same nonce incremented little-endian by 1 (libsodium sodium_increment). Error replies carry no nonce and are correlated by action.
frameRule: Native messaging frame = 4-byte little-endian payload length + UTF-8 JSON payload, max 1 MiB. `plaintextJson` is the exact UTF-8 string sealed into `frame.message`; it is null for unencrypted frames.
description: friendlypass host-level extensions. These are answered by friendlypass-browser-host itself, without cryptography, even when the app is down. They are NOT part of the KeePassXC protocol and the official extension never sends them.

vectors.name: host/ping-app-down
vectors.notes: Heartbeat while the app socket is down. The host stays alive; `appRunning: false` and null status fields are the signal to keep the extension in READY(app-down). The nonce is echoed verbatim (no increment).

vectors.name: host/ping-app-up
vectors.notes: Heartbeat with a live app socket. `locked`/`databaseHash` may lag by one heartbeat; do not use them as the sole source of truth.

vectors.name: host/hello-startup
vectors.notes: Connection negotiation at service-worker start. `sessionId` identifies this stdio connection in diagnostics. No nonce is used.

vectors.name: push/database-locked
vectors.notes: App -> extension broadcast, unencrypted, no nonce, no correlation. The official extension reacts by re-running test-associate (which then fails while locked).

vectors.name: push/database-unlocked
vectors.notes: App -> extension broadcast after unlock. Clients should re-run get-databasehash and test-associate because the hash may have changed.

vectors.name: push/database-changed
vectors.notes: friendlypass extension: the database contents/hash changed (edit, save, DB switch). Unencrypted, optional new hash. Not emitted by KeePassXC.
